ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: I chose Curlew because the request is open-ended generative work — brainstorming a comprehensive, thorough list rather than a tightly-specified extraction or transform. Lapwing self-reports a strong aversion to open-ended generative tasks (win-rate 35, its lowest), and although its measured Creative Generation capability is actually high and within tie range of Curlew's, I avoid routing a task to a model that least prefers that task family when a roughly equally capable alternative without that aversion exists. Curlew has no notable dispreference here, so it's the cleaner fit.
